intro.title: A complete bathroom, planned before it is built
paragraphs: Most of our bathroom work is a full renovation: the old room stripped out, the layout reworked where it helps, and a new bathroom tiled, fitted and finished. For many clients we prepare a 3D design first, so decisions on tiles, niches, lighting and brassware are made on screen rather than on site.

One practical point before you plan a rainfall shower: we do not fit booster pumps. A strong shower needs good mains pressure at the house, so raise it with us early and we will plan around what you have.

process.title: Tell us about the room
process.text: Send photos, rough sizes and what you want to change by WhatsApp, phone or the form.

process.title: Visit and design
process.text: We look at the room with you, agree the layout and finishes, and where useful prepare a 3D design.

process.title: Detailed written quotation
process.text: You receive a written quotation listing the work, the tiling extent and the fittings included.

process.title: Strip-out and build
process.text: Our team strips the room back and builds the new bathroom: plumbing, electrics, tiling and fitting.

process.title: Handover
process.text: We walk you through the finished room and its fittings before we leave.

faqs.q: Will I see the design before work starts?
faqs.a: Often, yes. We prepare 3D designs for many of our bathrooms so you can see the layout, tiles and fittings first. In Rathcoole the finished rooms match the 3D designs almost exactly.
Our standard is tiling to the shower area and the floor. If you want more walls tiled, it is listed and priced separately in your quotation.

faqs.q: Can you fit a booster pump for a stronger shower?
faqs.a: No, we do not fit booster pumps. A powerful shower depends on good mains pressure at your house, so it is worth raising early in the design.
The size of the room, whether the layout and drainage move, the tiling extent, and the tiles, sanitaryware and brassware you choose. Your detailed written quotation lists each item.
Yes. We have built en-suites under rooflights in attic conversions, including a Rathcoole attic en-suite designed in 3D first.

faqs.q: Do you work in my area?
faqs.a: We work within 50 km of Dunshaughlin, Co. Meath. That covers all of Dublin and towns in Meath, Kildare, Louth (such as Drogheda) and north Wicklow.
